Privacy & Terms

Read our Privacy Policy to see how we handle your information, and our Terms and Conditions for using this website.

Privacy Policy

Information You Share

When you call, email or message us on WhatsApp, we receive the information you choose to share. This may include your name, phone number, email address, project enquiry or land details. This website has no enquiry forms, customer accounts or online payments.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to respond to enquiries, share project and price details, discuss joint ventures and arrange visits.

Website and Service Data

Hosting and security services may process technical information, such as your IP address, browser details and access times, to deliver and protect the website. Google Maps and other services used on the site may also process information under their own privacy policies.

Sharing and Service Providers

We do not sell your personal information. We use services such as hosting, email and messaging to run the website and respond to you. These providers may process information as part of those services. We may also disclose information where required by law.

Google Maps and WhatsApp

This website uses Google Maps and links to WhatsApp. Their privacy practices are explained in the Google Privacy Policy and WhatsApp Privacy Policy.

Your Questions and Requests

To ask how we use your information, request a correction or ask us to delete details we hold, email wahiproperties.ltd@gmail.com or call us. We will explain whether any records need to be kept.

Last updated: 13 November 2026

Terms and Conditions

Project Information

This website introduces our projects. Please request the current plans, specifications and purchase terms before booking an apartment. The final details of a purchase are recorded in the agreement with you.

Photos and Illustrations

Some project images are architectural illustrations and are labelled as such. Ask us for current project photos and details if you need more information.

Prices and Availability

Prices and apartment availability are confirmed directly with us. A project listed on this website may not have apartments available for sale.

Bookings and Payments

Viewing this website or sending an enquiry does not reserve an apartment. Contact us directly to discuss a booking, payment schedule and written terms. This website does not accept online payments.

Website Content

Unless otherwise credited, the text, images and plans on this website belong to Wahi Properties Ltd or are used with permission. Please contact us before reusing them.

Updates and Applicable Law

We may update this page when our website or practices change. These terms and conditions are governed by the laws of Bangladesh.
